## B1 evidence and playability are still pending

All 40 case families and six legacy gates are **runtime UNEXECUTED_B1**, including the 35 new documentary run bindings. Genuine B1 must supply qualified source/backend/profile/RootSeal ids, same-path source hook lines/supervisor/API evidence, actual all-nine rows/head/ack chains, cold/old retry/optional-loss/resource costs and independently sealed W−1/W/W+1 controls. All eleven real numeric caps remain unknown; no measurements are fabricated. Required source/seam absence is BLOCKED, not a green skip.

The first B1 delivery must be fun as a **standalone playable social-strategy experience**, alongside technical C1-derived proofs. An explicit **separately reviewed B1 playability/scope amendment is required before implementation authorization**. The existing headless GF02 proof alone is not gameplay acceptance. No UI, gameplay loop, expanded fixture, benchmark, scope amendment or implementation is designed here.

No C2.2/P8 forgetting/relearning/disposition/subscribers/expiry/correction, full360, NPC population/generator/general elaboration runtime, additional coordination, migration, Unity, Governance, Combat/Physics/Factions/Laws or canonical repository work is authorized. **Stop for separate independent Auditor/Tester and owner assessment.**
